constraint_contract.principle: Generate structurally possible analyses, then remove incompatible analyses with source-backed hard constraints before using weaker lexical/semantic evidence.
constraint_contract.negative_policy: Absence of a licensing fact is not automatically a grammatical error; it may mean lexical coverage or capability is incomplete.
constraint_contract.resolution_policy: Resolve only when exactly one surviving candidate has sufficient positive evidence and no unresolved hard blocker; otherwise preserve ambiguity.
constraint_contract.learner_error_policy: Parser uncertainty, missing lexical mapping, missing valency and unresolved attachment are never learner errors.
constraint_contract.external_parser_policy: External statistical/AI parser outputs may later add evidence but cannot override source-verified hard constraints.
